title: 3.3.0 Beta 1 AAPS Sync/Websockets
symptom: When websockets are enabled, the AAPS Client does not receive data. The synchronization menu in AAPS Client cannot be opened. With older AAPS Client versions, websockets can remain enabled and data is received.
fix: For issue 1, the solution is to disable websockets on the AAPS Client while keeping them enabled on the master device.
evidence_quote: Update: Lösung zu 1. Master - Websockets AN, AAPS Client - Websockets AUS
